name: Morton-Partitioned Triangle Voxelization
definition: A voxelization pipeline that partitions a 3D grid into Morton-ordered subgrids, assigns triangles to subgrids via AABB overlap, and marks voxels using triangle-box intersection tests to build a Sparse Voxel Octree.
summary: Morton-Partitioned Triangle Voxelization is a streaming pipeline that builds Sparse Voxel Octrees by processing grids in Morton order, distinguishing itself through logarithmic memory management that enables out-of-core construction of large models.
